description: This file defines a React component 'TopReferralSourcesBarChart' that renders a responsive, horizontal bar chart visualizing top referral sources with user counts. It fetches data from an API, processes it, and displays it with custom tooltips and labels.

methods.name: TopReferralSourcesBarChart
methods.description: React functional component that displays a bar chart of top referral sources with data fetched from an API.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A custom tooltip component for displaying referral source counts on hover.

methods.name: valueLabel
methods.description: Renders value labels to the right of each bar in the chart.

methods.name: TruncatedTick
methods.description: Truncates long Y-axis labels with a tooltip showing the full text.
